'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Battle of Vuhledar]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] capture the town of [[Vuhledar]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], after [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] retreat from the town. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/10/01/russias-biggest-victory-since-february-ukrainian-stronghold/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***Seven people are killed and 12 others are injured in [[Russia]]n strikes in [[Kherson]] and [[Zaporizhzhia]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/six-killed-russian-strike-ukraines-kherson-2024-10-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
**[[October 2024 Iranian strikes against Israel]]
***[[Iran]] launches a wave of [[List of military equipment manufactured in Iran#Missiles|ballistic missile]] attacks against [[Israel]] in retaliation for the [[2024 Hezbollah headquarters strike]], killing a [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] [[civilian]] and injuring two others. The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] had previously warned of an imminent Iranian attack, saying that such an attack would carry "severe consequences for Iran". [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/oct/01/israel-lebanon-attacks-live-blog-ground-offensive-hezbollah-hamas-gaza-war (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/israel-iran-us-warns-ballistic-missile-attack-amid-idf-ground-operations-lebanon-hezbollah/ (CBS News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/10/01/politics/iran-missile-attack-israel/index.html (CNN)]
***[[United States Navy]] destroyers [[USS Bulkeley|USS ''Bulkeley'']] and [[USS Cole (DDG-67)|USS ''Cole'']] successfully shoot down several Iranian missiles heading towards Israel. [https://ukdefencejournal.org.uk/video-shows-american-warships-firing-at-iranian-missiles/ (UK Defence Journal)]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***The [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian military]] intercepts several [[Drone warfare|drone]]s or missiles over [[Damascus]]. Several of them explode in the [[Mezzeh]] neighborhood, killing three people and injuring nine others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/10/1/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-israelis-launch-ground-operation-in-lebanon?update=3212792 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.barrons.com/news/syrian-state-tv-says-journalist-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-damascus-d231ca68 (AFP via Barron's)] [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-822641 (''Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-has-indications-iran-preparing-launch-ballistic-missile-attack-israel-2024-10-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] invade southern [[Lebanon]] and begin a ground operation against [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/10/1/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-israelis-launch-ground-operation-in-lebanon (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-hamas-war/article-822644 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
**A rocket explosion is reported in [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]], with the debris severely injuring a man. Separately, a drone is intercepted by Israeli forces over the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/10/1/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-israelis-launch-ground-operation-in-lebanon?update=3212755 (Al Jazeera)]
**Israel launches an [[airstrike]] in the [[Ain al-Hilweh]] [[Palestinian refugee camps|refugee camp]] in [[Sidon]], Lebanon, in order to target Munir al-Maqdah, an official of the [[Al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigades]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/10/1/israel-attacks-lebanon-live-israelis-launch-ground-operation-in-lebanon?update=3212788 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[2024 Jaffa shooting]]
***Two [[Palestinian political violence|Palestinian gunmen]] open fire on pedestrians in [[Jaffa]], [[Israel]], killing at least seven people and injuring at least 17 others. The gunmen are subsequently shot and killed by armed civilians and [[Israel Police|police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/shooting-attack-tel-aviv-with-number-casualties-police-say-2024-10-01/ (Reuters)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/police-say-four-civilians-were-murdered-7-wounded-in-terror-shooting-attack-in-jaffa/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2024 United States port strike]]
**Over 45,000 [[dockworker]]s of the [[International Longshoremen's Association]] operating at thirty-six [[United States]] ports, primarily along the [[East Coast of the United States|East Coast]] and the [[Gulf Coast of the United States|Gulf Coast]], begin a [[Strike action|labor strike]], following the failure of the ports to reach a deal for worker compensation and a ban on [[automation]]. [https://apnews.com/article/port-strike-ila-dockworkers-begins-e5468e760f46a64e4322d1702beb1f72 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The death toll from [[Hurricane Helene]] surpasses 160 people, with most of the deaths occurring in [[North Carolina]], making it the [[List of disasters in the United States by death toll|second-deadliest]] hurricane to strike the contiguous [[United States]] in the past fifty years, behind only [[Hurricane Katrina]]. [https://www.cnn.com/weather/live-news/hurricane-helene-damage-north-carolina-10-01-24#cm1qu5gm900003b6sga6o6yfz (CNN)]
*[[2024 famine in Haiti]]
**An [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification]] report declares [[Famine|famine conditions]] in [[Haiti]], with nearly 48% of [[Haitians]] suffering from Stage 4 "crisis" levels of [[Food security|food insecurity]] and nearly 6,000 in [[Starvation|starvation]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/1/half-of-haitians-facing-hunger-as-violence-persists (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-hunger-starving-report-af625f8d80698788624dfbcc30c656a4 (AP)]
*[[2024 Lam Luk Ka bus crash]]
**A bus carrying [[school]] students and teachers crashes and catches fire in [[Lam Luk Ka District]], [[Pathum Thani Province]], [[Thailand]], killing 25 people, including 22 children, and injuring 19 others. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/501568349/bus-inferno-in-thailand-22-students-3-teachers-killed/ (Khmer Times)]
*[[Rwanda Marburg virus disease outbreak]]
**[[Rwanda]] reports eight deaths from [[Marburg virus]]. [https://apnews.com/article/rwanda-marburg-virus-c9728160abef2ca94395ec3ba4dfdc49 (AP News)] [https://www.usnews.com/news/health-news/articles/2024-10-01/outbreak-of-ebola-like-marburg-virus-in-rwanda-has-killed-8-people (''US News'')]
*At least 45 people are killed and dozens are missing after two boats carrying migrants capsizes off the coast of [[Djibouti]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/2/at-least-45-dead-dozens-missing-as-boats-sink-off-coast-of-djibouti (So Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Japanese general election]]
**[[Shigeru Ishiba]] is sworn in as the 65th [[prime minister of Japan]], succeeding [[Fumio Kishida]]. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20241001/p2g/00m/0na/029000c (''Mainichi'')] [https://apnews.com/article/japan-cabinet-kishida-ishiba-fa7f80b614a8bf298852b6766dbf6403 (AP)]
*[[2024 Mexican general election]]
**[[Claudia Sheinbaum]] is inaugurated as the 66th [[president of Mexico]], becoming the first female [[Mexico|Mexican]] president. [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2024/10/01/claudia-sheinbaum-mexico-first-female-president/75448711007/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[2024 United States presidential debates]]
**The [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] debate is held between [[Governor of Minnesota|Minnesota Governor]] [[Tim Walz]] and [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[JD Vance]]. [https://www.businessinsider.com/vance-walz-vp-vice-presidential-debate-highlights-2024-10 (Business Insider)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/vp-debate-vance-walz-2024/ (CBS News)]
*[[Jimmy Carter]], the 39th [[President of the United States|president]] of the [[United States of America|United States]], celebrates his 100th birthday, becoming the first [[centenarian]] former U.S. president. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyldnlrnxdo (BBC News)]
*Former [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] is installed as the 14th [[Secretary General of NATO]], succeeding [[Jens Stoltenberg]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/nato-chief-mark-rutte-takes-charge-at-critical-time/a-70355945 (DW)]
*[[Dalibor Riccardi]] and [[Francesca Civerchia]] are sworn in as the new [[Captains Regent|Captains Regents of San Marino]]. [https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/politica-c2/il-giorno-della-reggenza-francesca-civerchia-e-dalibor-riccardi-sono-i-capitani-reggenti-di-san-marino-a265201 (San Marino RTV)]
